Implement agentic architecture and hierarchical workflows:      Build finance AI agents that coordinate sub‑agents—for example, a Research Agent to fetch financial data, a Finance Agent to analyze transactions, and an Editor Agent to craft reports.Organize these into hierarchical-sequential or plan‑and‑execute flows for scalability and modularity
Continuous prompt refinement & iteration:      Use LLM feedback loops or "self‑reflection" to score outputs, detect hallucinations, and improve prompts over time.Set up pipelines for A/B testing, prompt versioning, and performance QA tailored to financial use cases Apply expertise in and potentially fine-tune leading LLMs (e.g., Google's Gemini, OpenAI's GPT series, Anthropic's Claude) to optimize AI Finance Employee performance.Optimize overall LLM system performance to ensure low latency and high efficiency across all financial AI applications.

AI Solution Development - Develop and optimize complementary AI components such as advanced customizable OCR models, intelligent chatbots, and automated approval systems to support financial workflows. Maintain a strong understanding of and stay current with the latest advancements, research, and best practices in large language model (LLM) technologies and AI to drive continuous innovation.

➕ We’re Particularly Interested In People Who Have      Experience with multiple LLM platforms and frameworks.Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and libraries.Knowledge of software engineering best practices and version control systems (git)
🙂Benefits      Competitive stipendPerformance based full-time role conversionBenefits package (post full-time conversion)Opportunity for career growth and skill development.Collaborative and innovative work environment.Flexible work hours and remote work options.

jobs.descriptionText:
Help build the next generation of developer tooling and agentic AI products! In this role you will work closely with a startup founder(Fred Weitendorf https://www.linkedin.com/in/fred-weitendorf-40b505b6/) and a team of founding engineers based out of San Francisco, creating a radically different way to develop software.This is a remote 10 week, fixed-term summer 2025 internship role available for undergrad, MS, and PhD B.Tech CSE and Computer Science students. Your contributions to Statue and Collector will play and important role in the success of these integrations, so you will work closely with the founding team on making sure that these projects are successful. The work will involve developing, integrating, and testing open source software, but also creating demonstrations and participating in various public events for these projects, as well as collaborating with the open source community.Responsibilities      Develop, integrate, and test open source softwareCollaborate with other interns, the Accretional team, and the open source communityCreate demonstrations and showcases for Statue, Collector, and Accretional's productsParticipate in public events, both Accretional's, and through third partiesDevelop AI workflows and agents to automate website, backend, database, and product creation.
